entries.label: rl_fmt
entries.note: Optimizer's trained policy: PPO from rl_o1000_0k over 40 rounds of 500 games (20,000 total). Weights are data/rl_o1000's round 40, published here. Provenance is eval/rl-single-train/README.md plus data/rl_o1000/MANIFEST.json, which records commit 88c8a18 without checking that the tree was clean - so records.json's commit stays null.

entries.label: rl_fmt
entries.note: Hunter's trained policy, plan10's four-at-once run at milestone 1: 60 more rounds of 500 games on top of rl_h1000_20k, so 100 rounds and 50,000 games in total. The file is data/multi/h's round 100, published here; the frozen 20k it started from stays a separate seat and the training pool was deliberately not widened with this row. Evidence: eval/rl-multiple-train/README.md plus the step_000060/80/100 snapshots.
